contract.absence_policy: 完整扫描确认缺失后才可运行有来源依据的结构提醒；本草案结构条目均unsupported，缺对象不检查字体。可选附录、图表清单、致谢等不产生缺失批注。未知、缺依赖及未实现静默。
contract.scope_policy: each evaluates on each confirmed selected object; document_group aggregates selected roles per document. Per-fact applicability is independent: not_applicable subchecks are skipped rather than failed. Confirmed failures still produce their own comments when another subcheck is unknown. Document-level absence checks run even if the missing structure has no selected node.
contract.role_membership_policy: A confirmed leaf role also matches its explicit transitive role_parents; generic selectors never require duplicate manual labels. Deduplicate by stable target ID. No other implicit inheritance. peer_heading includes reference, appendix, acknowledgements and symbol-list chapter-level headings, but excludes dedicated abstract/toc/list heading roles.

notification_policy.source_check_preserved: check records source requirements; audit defines executable subset, not all source assertions
notification_policy.override_semantics: audit.when adds conditions to rule.when; audit.roles replaces executable targets, including document-level missing-structure checks; audit.tests overrides check.tests for execution only, null uses original properties/assertions; audit.requires lists shared dependencies only. Other provider failures make only their own facts unknown, not all subchecks.
notification_policy.partial_result: 各子项分别判定；一项unknown不掩盖其他明确失败。结构缺失只出一条结构提示，不虚构格式问题。
